notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/rvl-lab-utoronto__panda_robot --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored (driver.lock.json authored_by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run ros-wave-c-137) and unreviewed; reviewed_by stays null; no hardware was attached and no hardware or sim run was made.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card asks for RosDriver/family:ros, but the confirmed entry PandaReacherEnv is an old Gym environment (gym.Env) whose step/reset/seed interface is the primary contract; it publishes a Twist through PandaClient inside the Python process rather than declaring a ROS transport endpoint. A Gymnasium environment does not become a ROS transport driver merely because its repository also contains ROS nodes, and RosDriver could not preserve the step/reset/seed interface. This package therefore subclasses GymnasiumDriver. The package does not serve a ROS or hardware backend; only the fake backend is declared.

Entry scope: the card lists three entry symbols. Only gym_panda_robot.envs:PandaReacherEnv is served (defined at src/gym-panda-robot/gym_panda_robot/envs/panda_reacher_env.py:23; registered at src/gym-panda-robot/gym_panda_robot/__init__.py:3-6). PandaPegInHoleEnv is not exported by envs/__init__.py, imports the missing panda_base_env, and its step has no action parameter (panda_peg_in_hole.py:12,45). PandaReacherEnv1 is registered but its module gym_panda_robot.envs.panda_reacher_manga is absent (envs/__init__.py:1-2). No upstream simulator or mock exists, so the fake is an analytic stand-in, not a recording; it was not compared with a live arm.

The upstream is Python 2 and hardware-in-the-loop for a real Franka Panda over ROS, MoveIt and franka_ros (panda_client.py:105,396; README.md:3,7,49-65); no upstream code was imported or run. The fake's action Box(-1, 1) with three values, its start pose, goal, threshold and velocity gain are placeholders (the goal and threshold are deliberately different from the upstream values cited in facts.md); the upstream defines no action space and no bound (panda_reacher_env.py:38-43,60-61), so action_space_ref is deliberately unset and the reference names the fake as the origin. The fake preserves the old Gym four-tuple and the source observation/reward rules but integrates a placeholder point mass; it does not model ROS, MoveIt, the arm, controllers, gripper, Kinect, contacts or sensor noise. NOT COVERED: live ROS/real-arm execution, a sim backend (not declared), rendering, snapshot/restore, and the upstream _max_episode_steps=50 limit (the environment's step never enforces it).

Safety: simulated R0 for the isolated fake (cap.world.* class floor). The e-stop is the runtime software latch; no native stop exists. A live binding to the arm would be at least R2 and is deliberately not exposed; it would need a human-reviewed deployment and an independent physical stop. The clone has no LICENSE file and the card/registry licence is NOASSERTION/unknown; publication review remains required.

Warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only arms the next reset; no environment call is expected), G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x2 for action_space/observation_space (Gymnasium interface from the external gym.Env base; the old upstream class defines no spaces), and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived seed/tick/action inputs (the simulator family carries no units). There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest printed by the last exact acceptance run; check-report.json is regenerated by each gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the GymnasiumDriver deviation, all 29 facts against the README, PandaReacherEnv, PandaClient and the package files, the placeholder action space and the fake. The facts hold apart from two narrowed ones (a 'so ...' inference on the Python 2 syntax; a no-clipping claim off preprocess_action's lines), but the environment has no hardware-free path: PandaReacherEnv drives a real Franka Panda through franka_ros (README.md:3, 7, 49-65; panda_client.py:169-175, 320-353), the clone has no simulator or mock, and it does not load as shipped (gym_panda_robot.envs imports the missing panda_reacher_manga module, envs/__init__.py:1-2; panda_client.py is Python 2). As for applied-ai-lab/ramp, a fake-only contract cannot stand in for that missing path, so the package is blocked (NO_HARDWARE_FREE_PATH) and its risk is R2 (an arm), stated here only: driver.py keeps R0 for the fake contract. The reviewer changed driver.py (the two facts, the docstring, a gap) and facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the fake gate still passes with the digest unchanged (sha256:9cc83cdedfc705f1e5891ab16a6e3f24c85b809d48e7c411e16ebbfddf3b036d), so collect.py reports RESULT_UNTRUSTED once the status is blocked. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Real hardware only: a Franka Panda on its FCI computer with a real-time NUC. step publishes end-effector velocity Twists on /franka_control/target_velocity with no bound (clipped only when leaving the safety zone), reset calls go_home, which switches controllers and moves the arm, and close() publishes an unacknowledged zero Twist; there is no stop. PandaPegInHoleEnv (panda-robot-v0) imports a missing panda_base_env and its step refers to an undefined action. Licence: NOASSERTION.
